title: 3 Panel Comic Strip Maker
description: The perfect format for quick jokes. Make 3-panel comics easily.
intro: Master the rule of three with this classic comic format.

faqs.question: When should I use a 3-panel layout?
faqs.answer: The 3-panel layout is ideal for quick, punchy jokes that follow the classic setup, conflict, and resolution structure.

faqs.question: Is a 3-panel strip better for social media?
faqs.answer: Yes, its horizontal format is very readable on mobile feeds and works perfectly for platforms like Twitter or Reddit.

faqs.question: Can I change the aspect ratio of the 3 panels?
faqs.answer: You can adjust the width of each individual panel to emphasize different moments in your story.

title: 4 Panel Comic Creator
description: Build traditional 4-panel comic strips for social media or webcomics.
intro: The gold standard for webcomics, giving you a bit more room for story.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of a 4-panel layout?
faqs.answer: The 4-panel layout gives you an extra beat to build tension or add a secondary joke before the final punchline.

faqs.question: How is a 4-panel strip usually structured?
faqs.answer: Commonly, panels 1 and 2 set the scene, panel 3 provides a twist or escalation, and panel 4 delivers the conclusion.

faqs.question: Is 4-panel the standard for webcomics?
faqs.answer: Yes, many of the world's most popular webcomics use a 4-panel square or horizontal grid for consistent daily storytelling.

title: 6 Panel Comic Strip Builder
description: Tell more complex stories with our 6-panel comic builder.
intro: For narratives that need more space to breathe and develop.

faqs.question: What kind of stories need 6 panels?
faqs.answer: 6 panels are great for short narratives that require more dialogue, character development, or a more complex series of events.

faqs.question: How should I arrange a 6-panel grid?
faqs.answer: A 2x3 or 3x2 grid is standard. A 2x3 grid works well for vertical scrolling, while a 3x2 grid is better for desktop screens.

faqs.question: Can I combine panels in a 6-panel layout?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can merge adjacent panels to create larger "hero" panels for significant moments in your 6-panel story.
